verdict.rationale: FireHydrant gives every incident an internal status page that receives all `/fh update` and Command Center updates. For incidents public to the organization, viewing it needs no auth or license, so stakeholders can follow along without joining the incident channel. AI incident summaries are available to anyone in the Slack workspace without a FireHydrant account, and an Audiences feature tailors them per stakeholder group. However, nothing in the evidence shows a way for stakeholders to subscribe to updates, so the subscription part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented subscribe/follow mechanism for stakeholders (email or Slack notifications on status-page updates), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
